name: Catavero – Bulk Product Editor for WooCommerce
author: bulkly

sections.description:
Catavero is a bulk product editor for WooCommerce designed to make product updates safer and faster.

The free version provides a complete single-action bulk editor: select products from the current editor page, preview changes before applying them, and restore supported edits from History with Undo.

Catavero supports editing:

  • Regular price and sale price
  • Price changes by set value, fixed amount, or percentage where applicable
  • Price rounding to .99, .95, or whole numbers
  • Stock quantity and stock status
  • Product status
  • Product categories (add/remove)
  • Product tags (add/remove)
  • Simple and variable WooCommerce products, including applicable variations

Filters include product search, category, tag, product status, stock status, and price range.

Catavero PRO

Catavero PRO is an optional paid add-on. It extends Catavero with features for larger stores and automated workflows, including background processing, scheduling, Multiple Actions, Jobs & Progress, Select all filtered, and Auto Revert.

The free plugin remains usable without purchasing Catavero PRO.

External services

Catavero includes the Freemius SDK for optional account, licensing, upgrade, and add-on functionality. Freemius may communicate with its servers when a user explicitly opts in or uses Freemius-powered account, licensing, purchase, or update features. Data handled by Freemius is subject to Freemius’s terms and privacy policy.

Freemius Terms of Service: https://freemius.com/terms/
Freemius Privacy Policy: https://freemius.com/privacy/

WooCommerce is required for Catavero’s product editing functionality.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload and activate Catavero, or install it from the WordPress Plugin Directory when available.
  3. Open Catavero from the WooCommerce admin menu.
  4. Filter and select products, choose an edit, and review the Preview before applying it.
  5. Use History to review supported edits and Undo them when needed.
sections.faq:
How many products can I edit with the free version?

The free version supports products shown on the current editor page.

Does Catavero work with variable products?

Yes. Catavero handles applicable edits for variable products and their variations according to WooCommerce product and stock behavior.

Can I preview changes before applying them?

Yes. Catavero uses a Preview step before Apply.

Can I undo an edit?

Supported edits are recorded in History and can be restored with Undo.

Is Catavero PRO required?

No. Catavero FREE works on its own. Catavero PRO is an optional paid add-on for larger edits and automation features.

\n= 0.6.5 =
* Renamed the public plugin brand to Catavero – Bulk Product Editor for WooCommerce.
* Updated the WordPress.org text domain and package identity for the new Catavero slug.
* Kept legacy internal integration hooks and identifiers for compatibility with the existing PRO add-on.

0.6.4

  • Prepared the plugin naming and WordPress.org metadata for directory review.
  • Improved request sanitization for WordPress.org review compliance.

0.6.3

  • Kept the WordPress.org plugin focused on the complete single-action FREE editor.
  • Moved remaining background and Multiple Actions implementation details into the separately distributed PRO add-on.
  • Added neutral extension hooks for external add-ons without embedding paid feature implementations.

0.6.2

  • Expose the shared calculation helper for the external Catavero PRO add-on.

0.6.1

  • Restored FREE editor pagination after the architecture split.

0.6.0

  • Removed the paid 20-product usage cutoff from FREE.
  • FREE is a complete single-action editor for products shown on the current editor page.
  • Moved background jobs, scheduling, Select all filtered, Jobs & Progress and Auto Revert to the separately distributed PRO add-on.
  • Added extension hooks used by the PRO add-on while keeping FREE fully usable on its own.

0.5.9

  • Prepared the free parent plugin for the Catavero PRO add-on integration.
  • Includes preview, history and undo workflows for supported free edits.
  • FREE is a complete single-action editor with Preview, Apply, History and Undo. It does not use a paid usage cutoff.
